audit_items.proof_trace: Spec INV-003 (SG-010) requires ADLBorrow to reduce obligation debt without seizing collateral, but `handle_debt_auto_deleverage` routes through the shared `liquidation_inner` (L691-793) which unconditionally calls `obligation.withdraw_ctokens(seized_ctokens)` at L776. `seized_ctokens` is computed by `liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens` (L1031-1074) as repay_amount × (1 + liquidation_incentive) × price_ratio / exchange_rate — provably non-zero for any non-zero repay. No code branch exists in `liquidation_inner` to skip collateral seizure for the ADL Borrow path; both ADLBorrow and ADLCollateral share identical logic.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A privileged ADL operator invokes `liquidate_adl_borrow` when system-level borrow limits are breached, causing `obligation.withdraw_ctokens` to seize collateral from the targeted obligation. Per spec the obligation holder's collateral should remain untouched (only debt is reduced), but they instead lose collateral proportional to the repay amount plus the liquidation incentive.
